Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has given voters an election ultimatum: Vote for him or vote for Palestine. And Israelis mark three years in the Jewish calendar since the October 7th attacks.

Al Jazeera’s Mohammad Saleh has the latest.
